title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Given a string s, return the length of the longest substring that contains no repeated characters.

reference.use_case: Finding the longest continuous run of events in which no item repeats, such as the longest stretch of a browsing session without revisiting a page.
system_examples: IPsec anti-replay protection (RFC 4303) — tracking recently seen sequence numbers to reject duplicate packets
Stream processors (Apache Flink, Kafka Streams) — maintaining per-key windows over event streams with uniqueness constraints
Feed and playlist systems — ensuring a contiguous run of shown items contains no repeats
reference.explanation: A sliding window plus a hash map of each character's last index lets the left edge jump past a repeat instead of restarting, giving O(n). Growing and shrinking a window that maintains an invariant is the core of windowed stream processing and replay detection.
